result: Design doc docs/design/loadtime-entry.md: recommends per-class bodies installed once at start-up into a slot page by an mremapped private copy (M4): zero per-call cost on both classes, live text never writable, falls back to SSE2 on failure. Includes story plan, D-4.53 text and rulings.

gate.affected: not run (design only, no product code)

rulings.item: Replace a libc text page at start-up with a patched private file-backed copy (W^X kept, live page never writable)
rulings.recommendation: approve: no per-call test, no code pointer, every failure keeps the SSE2 baseline

rulings.item: Start-up cost on the AVX2 class: about 6 syscalls + one private page per process
rulings.recommendation: accept unless CLASSED-SLOT-INFRA's start-up row measures worse; then use IFUNC + RELRO for libc.so.6 only

rulings.item: Optional: move the remaining start-up words (avx2, scan_level, cmp_*) into RELRO in static programs
rulings.recommendation: small follow-up after the compare slots land
